fields.name: Full Fursuits
fields.description: Step into the world of full fursuits—complete, head-to-custom character costumes that bring your fursona to life with incredible detail and craftsmanship

fields.name: Heads
fields.description: A fully crafted fursuit head that captures your fursona's expression with detailed fur work, expressive eyes, and a comfortable, wearable fit

fields.name: Ears
fields.description: A pair of attachable fursuit ears that add the perfect finishing touch to your character, crafted with detailed fur work and designed for a secure, comfortable fit

fields.name: Paws
fields.description: A pair of fursuit paws that complete your character with detailed fur work, soft padding, and a comfortable fit for both display and wear

fields.name: Tails
fields.description: A fursuit tail that adds expressive movement and character to your costume, crafted with detailed fur work and designed for a secure, comfortable attachment

fields.name: Ears, Paws and Tail Sets
fields.description: A coordinated fursuit accessory set featuring ears, paws, and a tail, crafted with matching fur work and designed for a secure, comfortable fit to complete your character
